Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer made an error in identifying the paternal lineage. The search results provided focused incorrectly on Friedrich, Prince of Waldeck and Pyrmont, instead of directing the search toward Princess Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen. This misstep resulted from superficial utilization of search results without adequate validation or refinement to draw accurate and relevant genealogical information. The focus should have been on Princess Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen as the grandmother of Princess Augusta of Waldeck-Pyrmont, but the initial results and subsequent searches failed to resolve and confirm this foundational relationship correctly.
